description: This file defines the MessageOnlyLogFilter class, which implements the LogNode interface. It acts as a filter that passes through only log messages, removing metadata like tags and priorities. It's used for simplifying log output, such as on-screen log displays in Android applications.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A LogNode implementation that filters out all log metadata except the message. It can be chained to other LogNodes.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the LogNode chain with the provided next node.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter (no-arg)
methods.description: Default constructor, does not set the next LogNode.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Receives log data, forwards only the message (msg) to the next LogNode, ignoring other parameters.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
